entries.title: Job 11:1
segments: ¶And Zophar the Naamathite answered and said,

entries.title: Job 11:2
segments: Should not the multitude of words be answered? and should a man of much talk be justified?

entries.title: Job 11:3
segments: Should thy fictions make men hold their peace? and shouldest thou mock, and no one make [thee] ashamed?

entries.title: Job 11:4
segments: For thou sayest, My doctrine is pure, and I am clean in thine eyes.

entries.title: Job 11:5
segments: But oh that +God would speak, and open his lips against thee;

entries.title: Job 11:6
segments: And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, how that they are the double of what is realised; and know that +God passeth by [much] of thine iniquity!

entries.title: Job 11:7
segments: ¶Canst thou by searching find out +God? canst thou find out the Almighty to perfection?

entries.title: Job 11:8
segments: [It is as] the heights of heaven; what wilt thou do? deeper than Sheol; what canst thou know?

entries.title: Job 11:9
segments: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

entries.title: Job 11:10
segments: If he pass by, and shut up, and call to judgment, who can hinder him?

entries.title: Job 11:11
segments: For he knoweth vain men, and seeth wickedness when [man] doth not consider it;

entries.title: Job 11:12
segments: Yet a senseless man will make bold, though man be born [like] the foal of a wild ass.

entries.title: Job 11:13
segments: ¶If thou prepare thy heart and stretch out thy hands toward him,

entries.title: Job 11:14
segments: If thou put far away the iniquity which is in thy hand, and let not wrong dwell in thy tents;

entries.title: Job 11:15
segments: Surely then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot, and thou shalt be stedfast and shalt not fear:

entries.title: Job 11:16
segments: For thou shalt forget misery; as waters that are passed away shalt thou remember it;

entries.title: Job 11:17
segments: And life shall arise brighter than noonday; though thou be enshrouded in darkness, thou shalt be as the morning,

entries.title: Job 11:18
segments: And thou shalt have confidence, because there shall be hope; and having searched about [thee], thou shalt take rest in safety.

entries.title: Job 11:19
segments: Yea, thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; and many shall seek thy favour.

entries.title: Job 11:20
segments: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and [all] refuge shall vanish from them, and their hope [shall be] the breathing out of life.
